recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for FHIR-17192. No core source follow-up is needed for this issue unless the Security WG later wants to revise the informative example set or add stronger narrative around nonrepudiation.
issue_request: FHIR-17192 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked how to represent verification or denial of critical information without changing the verified resource content, and the accepted resolution was to provide Provenance examples showing increasing nonrepudiation: an electronic signature without cryptographic nonrepudiation, a JPEG image of an ink signature without cryptographic nonrepudiation, and XML-Signature examples.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found for FHIR-17192. The application appears to be the pre-applied Security WG example batch in git commit 8e5295fb536eb941d028df228f83035447240125, which added source/provenance/provenance-example-diagnosticreport-sig.xml, source/provenance/provenance-example-advanced.xml, list-Provenance entries for those examples, and updates to existing signature examples. The Security WG minutes for 2022-09-05 explicitly list FHIR-17192, the four Provenance example URLs named in the Jira resolution, and state that all three pre-applied Jira tickets were reviewed and approved.
additional_context: Provenance is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current source/provenance/list-Provenance-examples.xml indexes provenance-example-diagnosticreport-sig, provenance-example-advanced, provenance-consent-signature, and provenance-example-sig, and the corresponding XML examples still show verification/signature patterns. Focused Jira and Zulip searches found no later or conflicting community evidence for FHIR-17192.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Provenance source already carries the requested informative examples: a DiagnosticReport verification without content change using Provenance.activity=verify and a signature, an advanced example with sigFormat image/jpeg, and two XML-Signature examples using application/signature+xml.
